title: Check in for a flight
subtitle: Finds your booking and checks you in
description: Your Sylo finds the booking in your email, opens the airline’s own check-in page and checks you in with the details you saved, so your boarding pass is ready before you leave. It tells you if check-in isn’t open yet, and it stops and asks before anything that costs money or that you haven’t chosen, such as a paid seat or a bag. It never pays here.
asks: Check me in for my flight tomorrow.
Check me and Nora in for the 7:40 to Lisbon on Friday.
browserNote: It opens the airline’s page and fills in your saved details.
